concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-008 (independence of thermal conductivity values) is not linked to any task. T011 performs an independence check but is not tagged with [FR-008]; add an explicit task (e.g., T030) that verifies FR-008 and includes a verification step.

Success Criterion SC-003 (consistency of correlation coefficient across three system sizes) has no dedicated verification task. Add a task that computes and asserts the variance of correlation coefficients across the three sizes meets the specification.

Success Criterion SC-005 (pipeline runtime ≤ 30 minutes on a 4000‑atom system) is not covered by any task. Add a task that measures total pipeline runtime and fails if it exceeds the 30‑minute threshold.
